methodology: Period
January 3, 2022–December 31, 2025. All strategies use the same 1,003 daily observations.
Financial metrics
Net returns at base modeled costs in the first three tabs. The Extended-hours tab also discloses individual seeds and 2x/4x fee stresses.
Sharpe ratio
Annualized daily SR = sqrt(252) × [mean(daily return) − ((1.03)^(1/252)−1)] / sample SD(daily return).
95% Sharpe interval
Pointwise 2.5th/97.5th percentiles from 10,000 circular moving-block resamples. Primary block: 20 sessions.
Dependence
The same date-block draws apply to every strategy. Stocks, bars and seeds are not treated as independent observations.
Sharpe annualization
Conventional annualized daily ratio, matching existing reports. It is not a separately autocorrelation-adjusted annual-holding-period Sharpe.
RankIC
Mean per-origin cross-sectional Spearman correlation of ensemble scores with realized five-session STOCK returns, among observed eligible labels.
RankIC comparability
Raw-return RankIC throughout, including models trained on QQQ residuals. Approximately 200 complete forecast origins.
RankIC for overlays
RankIC describes the underlying stock forecast. Changing exposure or portfolio size does not change that forecast’s RankIC.
N/A
SPY, QQQ, the monthly equal-weight basket and single-ETF trend timing do not provide stock rankings. Their RankIC is not applicable.
Defensive rule
Trend-half policies target full stock exposure when signal-time QQQ is at/above MA200, half exposure plus cash otherwise.
Portfolio variants
Top-five/top-twenty holdings and original cash/short allocations. Short accounts include 3% annual borrow, with borrow availability assumed.
Excluded repetitions

Main tabs omit reference aliases, individual seeds, fee stresses and seed-bootstrap accounts. All 66 extended-hours accounts are separately disclosed. Original-five daily and the three base-cost benchmarks reuse existing main-table rows.
Historical scope
Active historical monthly Nasdaq-100 only. Retired 2026-selected survivor universes and deferred NYSE studies are excluded.
Interpretation
Previously inspected historical development. Intervals condition on fitted paths and omit full research-search, refit, data-revision and future-regime uncertainty.
Comparison warning
A strategy’s SR interval is not an interval for its advantage over SPY/QQQ. Overlap or zero inclusion alone is not a paired superiority test.
Sensitivities
Five- and 60-session block intervals are included in the accompanying sensitivity CSV. No block chosen for favorable bounds.
Source studies

Audited original monthly/top-k/long-short, matched Alpaca, ranking, broad-feature, frozen-core correction and seed-expansion studies. Extended-hours and premarket information study (October 24) is included.
Block-bootstrap reference
Politis and Romano, A Circular Block-Resampling Procedure for Stationary Data: https://statistics.stanford.edu/technical-reports/circular-block-resampling-procedure-stationary-data
Sharpe reference
Andrew W. Lo, The Statistics of Sharpe Ratios (2002): https://alo.mit.edu/publications/page/18/
Extended-hours clock
AH: prior regular close through 20:00 ET. PM: next exchange session 04:00–09:15 ET. All views decide at 09:20 ET and fill at that session’s regular close.
Extended-hours seeds
Primary ten seeds are fixed before metrics. Original-five and new-five ensembles and all individual seeds are diagnostics. The original five daily forecasts reproduce the earlier model.
Extended-hours limits

About 50% of member sessions have at least four AH bars and 46% have at least four PM bars. Missing activity is flagged. PM prior-close price gaps were excluded to avoid raw corporate-action discontinuities.
Current leaders

Highest base-cost CAGR: StockMixer top 5. Highest base-cost Sharpe: StockMixer top 5, 75% long / 25% short. Highest standard top-10 ensemble CAGR: original-five THINK + mixer with AH + PM. These are historical rankings, not forward selection rules.
Seed evidence
AH + PM improved 5/10 individual seeds. Its original-five CAGR rose from 19.60% to 22.39%, but the new-five group fell from 15.51% to 13.69%. Primary paired intervals include zero.
Sources and charts

See root charts.md for every main strategy and all additional extended-hours seed/cost accounts, source report links and paired uncertainty. Updated analysis: update_ndx_strategy_comparison_20261024.py.
AH+PM holding counts
Saved forecasts tested at five and ten holdings, same execution and costs. The original-five AH+PM ensemble returned 14.51% CAGR at top five versus 22.39% at top ten. No new training.
Top-five follow-up detail

AH PM holding counts contains all 62 accounts, including daily controls, seed groups, individual seeds and costs. Five new distinct base-cost ensembles are appended to Portfolio variants. See the master charts and audited top-five report.
New experiments
Both completed studies are independently audited. All 2022–2025 results remain exploratory development evidence. Models adds 33 top-ten rows; Portfolio variants adds 33 top-five rows.
Still uses THINK
The AH+PM dynamic rank blend retains the original THINK+mixer core and its AH+PM branch. A separately trained restricted dynamic hypergraph network supplies complementary rankings.
Fixed rank blend

Each network averages eligible cross-sectional percentile ranks across the same fixed seeds. Final score is 0.5 × THINK ensemble rank + 0.5 × dynamic ensemble rank. Select one top-five or top-ten equal-weight portfolio. No blend weights were fitted to test returns.
Trading clock
AH/PM features end at 09:15 ET, decision at 09:20, fill at that session’s regular close. Rebalance every five exchange sessions. These are regular-close trades using extended-hours information.
Seed comparison

Ten seeds are primary. Original-five and new-five halves diagnose initialization sensitivity on the same market history. They are not independent market periods. New findings places both halves beside each ten-seed result.
Reference adaptations

Author neural code was transferred to common NASDAQ features and declared training limits. Restricted dynamic uses one train-only correlation graph rather than the full sector/lead-lag pipeline. PRISM uses lagged JKP themes with unresolved historical publication-vintage limitations.
Loss and optimizer scope

Huber and pseudo-Huber use delta=1 percentage point. Optimizer rates were selected only from prior-year validation MSE. SGD keeps MSE and momentum 0.9. Shared MSE stopping means this is a finite recipe comparison, not proof of a universally best loss or optimizer.
Uncertainty and confirmation

Absolute SR intervals use a 3% annual hurdle and 10,000 circular-block draws, 20 sessions primary. Paired benchmark and within-batch simultaneous intervals are in the source studies. Conditional path intervals omit the full prior search and retraining uncertainty. No untouched-period superiority is established.
New result sources

Sealed local studies: runs/ndx_loss_optimizer_20261024 and runs/ndx_reference_networks_20261024. Metrics, ranking, curves, SR intervals, paired intervals and audit records supply the new rows. New accounts retains all 346 declared accounts, including repeated controls.
